project.name: India OTT Search
project.description: A static, backend-free web app for semantic search over India OTT catalog data. Visitors bring their own LLM API key and watch history; search runs entirely in the browser over a shipped catalog snapshot.

nodes.name: check_catalog.mjs
nodes.summary: Dependency-free smoke test, run directly with node, that exercises catalog.js's tokenize, normalizeTitle, buildIndex, search, and filterIndices against a small fixture dataset and asserts the expected outputs.

nodes.name: history.js
nodes.summary: Parses a raw Netflix 'viewing activity' CSV export into structured series/movie lists and a normalized set of watched titles.

nodes.name: check_history.mjs
nodes.summary: Dev-only smoke test verifying that the Netflix history CSV parser correctly extracts series, movies, and watched titles from a fixture file.

nodes.name: parseCsv
nodes.summary: Low-level RFC4180-style CSV tokenizer that handles quoted fields, escaped quotes, and CRLF/LF row boundaries, returning an array of row arrays.

nodes.name: parseDate
nodes.summary: Parses Netflix's localized M/D/YY date strings into a zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD ISO date string.

nodes.name: parseNetflixCsv
nodes.summary: Parses a raw Netflix viewing-history CSV export into de-duplicated series (with episode counts and last-watched dates) and movies lists, plus a normalized set of watched titles.

nodes.name: summarize
nodes.summary: Produces a short human-readable summary string reporting the counts of parsed series and movies.

nodes.name: CATALOG-STRATEGY.md
nodes.summary: Decision log aggregating three parallel India OTT sourcing research tracks (direct-platform scraping, aggregator/commercial APIs, free/AVOD sources) into a single strategy: adopt the Streaming Availability API as the primary multi-provider catalog source, keep uNoGSNG for deep Netflix data, and defer TMDB enrichment, Watchmode verification, and scraping behind future user-provided keys.

nodes.name: india-ott-aggregators-coverage.md
nodes.summary: Coverage research comparing commercial OTT catalog aggregators and APIs (JustWatch, Watchmode, Streaming Availability API, TMDB watch/providers, uNoGSNG, Reelgood, FlixPatrol) for India availability data, with a coverage matrix, deep-dive notes per aggregator, and signup/curl quick-start examples.

nodes.name: india-ott-p0-catalog-scrape-playbook.md
nodes.summary: Deep research and live-probe playbook investigating direct-scrape feasibility for major India OTT platforms (JioHotstar, Netflix India, ZEE5, SonyLIV, Prime Video, and regional apps), capturing raw BFF response samples and proposing a normalized SQLite/DuckDB catalog schema with ready-to-run experiment scripts.

nodes.name: india-ott-p1-free-firecrawl-playbook.md
nodes.summary: Track 3 research playbook evaluating free and ad-supported (AVOD) India OTT sources (YouTube, Dailymotion, Amazon MX Player, FAST channels, Archive.org, regional free tiers), benchmarking Firecrawl against native APIs and proposing a standardized catalog schema with runnable harvester experiments.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Setup and usage guide for catalog.py: the four commands to run (sweep, restricted test run, --enrich, --diff), JustWatch attribution requirements, sharding rationale, expected data volumes, and the weekly cron line.

nodes.name: catalog.py
nodes.summary: TMDB sweep CLI: sweeps TMDB discover + watch/providers (region IN) into catalog/catalog.db, with sweep/enrich/diff subcommands, provider-sharded pagination, and PID-based file locking. The primary build-time data-collection entry point for the catalog/ subproject.

nodes.name: get_token
nodes.summary: Reads the TMDB v4 read-access token from the project-root .env file (via load_dotenv) or the environment, exiting with an error if neither is set.

nodes.name: build_shard_params
nodes.summary: Builds the query parameter dict for one discover-API shard, combining provider, media type, monetization, release-year range, and optional language filter.

nodes.name: acquire_lock
nodes.summary: Acquires an exclusive PID-based lock file for the SQLite DB, refusing to start if a live process already holds it and cleaning up stale locks left by dead PIDs.

nodes.name: upsert_title
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a title row (movie or TV) in SQLite from a TMDB discover result, storing genre IDs, popularity, and original language.

nodes.name: fetch_json
nodes.summary: Performs a single rate-limited HTTP GET against the TMDB API with bounded concurrency, exponential backoff on 429s, and retry accounting in a shared stats dict.

nodes.name: fetch_shard
nodes.summary: Pages through one discover-query shard up to TMDB's 500-page cap, recursively subdividing by original_language when a shard's first page still reports overflow.

nodes.name: sweep_provider_media
nodes.summary: Sweeps one (provider, media_type) pair across all monetizations and year buckets, fetching every shard and upserting titles/availability rows into SQLite.

nodes.name: cmd_sweep
nodes.summary: Implements the `sweep` CLI subcommand: acquires the DB lock, initializes the schema, discovers providers, sweeps each provider/media-type combination concurrently, records a snapshot row, and reports summary stats.

nodes.name: _run_enrich
nodes.summary: Backfills imdb_id and runtime for every title still missing imdb_id by concurrently calling the TMDB details+external_ids endpoint and writing results back to SQLite.

nodes.name: cmd_diff
nodes.summary: Implements the offline `--diff` CLI subcommand, comparing the latest two snapshot dates and printing new-arrival/leaving/provider/language breakdown reports without any network calls.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Argparse-based CLI entry point wiring up the sweep, enrich, and diff subcommands with their shared flags (region, db path, types, monetization, providers, concurrency).

nodes.name: availability
nodes.summary: Five read-only example SQL queries against catalog.db's availability/title/provider/snapshot tables: new arrivals this week, titles leaving soon, titles on multiple providers, catalog size by provider, and catalog size by original language.

nodes.name: smoke_test.py
nodes.summary: Test suite for catalog.py exercising sharding/pagination edge cases (overflow shards, small shards, shard-parameter building) using fake async HTTP fetchers instead of real TMDB calls.

nodes.name: fake_overflow_shard
nodes.summary: Test double simulating a discover-API shard whose first page reports more pages than the 500-page cap, used to verify catalog.py's language-based subdivision logic in fetch_shard.

nodes.name: viewing_history
nodes.summary: Small hand-crafted sample mimicking Netflix's exported viewing-history CSV format (Title, Date columns), used as fixture data for testing the browser-side watch-history CSV upload/parse feature.

nodes.name: .nojekyll
nodes.summary: Empty marker file telling GitHub Pages to skip Jekyll processing so the static docs/ site is served as-is.

nodes.name: build_catalog.py
nodes.summary: Older/legacy catalog-builder CLI predating the TMDB-only pipeline: normalizes raw uNoGS and StreamingAvailability API dumps into the shared catalog schema and merges them into a single output; superseded by build_catalog_tmdb.py.

nodes.name: normalize_unogs
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw uNoGS API dump record into the project's common catalog schema (title, type, providers, images, language).

nodes.name: _smallest_image
nodes.summary: Picks the smallest usable poster/backdrop image URL from a record's image candidates to minimize payload size.

nodes.name: normalize_streaming_availability
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw Streaming Availability API record (legacy RapidAPI source) into the common catalog schema, mapping provider IDs and monetization types.

nodes.name: _merge_records
nodes.summary: Merges two normalized catalog records that refer to the same title, unioning their provider/availability lists.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Main build routine: reads the raw legacy source dumps, normalizes and merges them by title, and writes the combined catalog JSON output.

nodes.name: fetch_streaming_availability.py
nodes.summary: Legacy/retired CLI that queried the RapidAPI 'Streaming Availability' service for India OTT catalogs. Per the project README, no RapidAPI is used anywhere in the current pipeline — this script remains on disk for provenance only and is not part of the build or runtime flow.

nodes.name: ApiClient
nodes.summary: HTTP client wrapper for the legacy RapidAPI Streaming Availability service, tracking quota budget, issuing rate-limited GET requests, and recording usage from response headers.

nodes.name: apply_quota_guardrail
nodes.summary: Checks RapidAPI rate-limit headers against a configured safety margin and raises QuotaExhausted before further calls would exceed the plan's quota.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Issues a single probe request against a streaming-availability service endpoint and reports quota/response status, used for exploratory API testing.

nodes.name: fetch_service
nodes.summary: Core legacy fetch routine that pages through one streaming service's full catalog via the RapidAPI endpoint, applying the quota guardrail and retry logic.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the legacy fetch script: parses arguments, iterates configured services/regions, and writes raw JSON dumps to disk for later processing.

nodes.name: finalize_probes.py
nodes.summary: One-off legacy script that folds ad-hoc JustWatch and open-datasets probe results into finalized JSON probe files, part of the retired exploratory data-collection phase and not used by the current build.

nodes.name: update_justwatch_probe
nodes.summary: Reads an existing JustWatch probe JSON dump and rewrites/normalizes it into the finalized probe format used by later analysis.

nodes.name: create_open_datasets_probe
nodes.summary: Builds a finalized probe JSON file summarizing findings from public open-dataset sources explored during the research phase.

nodes.summary: Fetches a Zee5 listing page and extracts titles from its grid markup.

nodes.name: unogs_dump_catalog.py
nodes.summary: Legacy/retired CLI that dumped a country's full Netflix catalog via the uNoGS RapidAPI service. Per the project README, no RapidAPI is used anywhere in the current pipeline — this script remains on disk for provenance only and is not part of the build or runtime flow.

nodes.name: _http_get_json
nodes.summary: Low-level HTTP GET helper for the uNoGS API with the RapidAPI key header, retry handling, and JSON decoding.

nodes.name: get_countries
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches the uNoGS API's list of supported countries and their IDs/codes.

nodes.name: match_country
nodes.summary: Resolves a user-supplied country name or code to the matching uNoGS Country record.

nodes.name: _search_page
nodes.summary: Fetches one page of uNoGS search results for a given country's Netflix catalog.

nodes.name: _canonicalize_title
nodes.summary: Cleans and canonicalizes a raw uNoGS title string for consistent downstream matching and deduplication.

nodes.name: dump_country_catalog
nodes.summary: Pages through and dumps a country's entire Netflix catalog from uNoGS to a local JSON file, handling pagination and rate limits.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for the legacy uNoGS dump script: parses country/output arguments and invokes dump_country_catalog.

nodes.name: catalog.js
nodes.summary: Client-side inverted-index search engine for the India OTT catalog using BM25 scoring with title normalization, tokenization, indexing, full-text search, and structured record filtering.

nodes.name: normalizeTitle
nodes.summary: Normalizes titles by stripping diacritics, lowercasing, and collapsing non-alphanumeric characters for consistent matching.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Splits normalized text into search terms, dropping stop words and tokens shorter than two characters.

nodes.name: buildIndex
nodes.summary: Builds an inverted index with document frequency, postings lists, average document length, and vote metadata from catalog records.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Runs BM25 full-text search over the inverted index with optional allow-list filtering and vote-based score boosting.

nodes.name: filterIndices
nodes.summary: Returns record indices matching structured filters such as year, runtime, rating, provider, genre, language, and excluded titles.

nodes.name: tools.js
nodes.summary: Factory that exposes LLM-callable tool schemas and handlers for searching, filtering, fetching, and sampling India OTT catalog titles via injected catalog dependencies.

nodes.name: createTools
nodes.summary: Creates OpenAI function-calling schemas and async handlers that delegate to injected search, filter, and record dependencies for four catalog operations.

nodes.name: check_tools.mjs
nodes.summary: Integration test script validating createTools handlers against a fixture catalog, covering search, filter, get, and sample operations plus schema shape.

nodes.name: stress_search_perf.mjs
nodes.summary: Performance regression script that loads the full catalog JSON and asserts index build time, heap retention, and query latency percentiles stay within thresholds.

nodes.name: exporters.js
nodes.summary: Pure export formatters that convert search pick arrays into Markdown, JSON, CSV, and You.md strings without DOM or external dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Side-effect-free module with provider label lookup tables and CSV escaping helpers.

nodes.name: toMarkdown
nodes.summary: Renders ranked watch picks as a Markdown document with numbered titles, metadata facts, provider links, and reasons.

nodes.name: toJson
nodes.summary: Serializes picks and query metadata to a pretty-printed JSON string for download.

nodes.name: toCsv
nodes.summary: Builds a CSV export with header row and escaped fields for titles, genres, providers, and streaming URLs.

nodes.name: toYouMd
nodes.summary: Appends a Recently watched section to a You.md profile from parsed Netflix history series and movie lists.

nodes.name: ui.js
nodes.summary: Main browser UI controller that loads catalog data, wires search and settings dialogs, renders result cards, and orchestrates the LLM agent with export and facet filtering.
nodes.languageNotes: Large imperative DOM module with module-level state for catalog index, picks, and localStorage-backed settings.

nodes.name: collectDom
nodes.summary: Resolves required DOM element IDs into a camelCase property map and logs missing nodes.

nodes.name: buildPoster
nodes.summary: Creates a poster image element or initials fallback placeholder for a result card.

nodes.name: metaLine
nodes.summary: Builds a metadata line element showing year, runtime, rating, and kind for a pick.

nodes.name: linkRow
nodes.summary: Renders a row of streaming provider links with human-readable labels for a pick.

nodes.name: buildCard
nodes.summary: Assembles a full result card DOM subtree with poster, title, metadata, reason, and provider links.

nodes.name: renderPicks
nodes.summary: Clears the results container and appends one card per pick or a no-results message.

nodes.name: download
nodes.summary: Triggers a browser file download from an in-memory Blob with the given filename and MIME type.

nodes.name: scheduleIndex
nodes.summary: Defers catalog inverted-index construction to an idle callback or timeout so initial paint stays fast.

nodes.name: scheduleSidecar
nodes.summary: Lazy-loads optional sidecar JSON data in the background after the main catalog is ready.

nodes.name: makeTools
nodes.summary: Constructs agent tool handlers bound to the current catalog index, facet filters, and deduplication keys.

nodes.name: hydrate
nodes.summary: Enriches a compact agent result row with full catalog record fields from the in-memory records map.

nodes.name: makeEventHandler
nodes.summary: Returns a callback that logs agent trace events, updates status notes, and renders incremental pick results.

nodes.name: onSubmit
nodes.summary: Handles search form submission by running the LLM agent or falling back to keyword search when no API key is configured.

nodes.name: readHistoryFile
nodes.summary: Reads a Netflix viewing-history CSV upload, parses it, and displays a human-readable summary in the context dialog.

nodes.name: wireSettings
nodes.summary: Binds the LLM settings dialog open, save, and close handlers to localStorage via the store module.

nodes.name: wireContext
nodes.summary: Wires the You.md and Netflix history context dialog for file upload, preview, and persistence.

nodes.name: fillSelect
nodes.summary: Populates a facet select element with placeholder and labeled option values.

nodes.name: fillCatalogDetail
nodes.summary: Updates the catalog status detail line with region, build timestamp, and record count.

nodes.name: wireExports
nodes.summary: Attaches click handlers to export buttons that download picks as Markdown, JSON, CSV, or You.md.

nodes.name: loadData
nodes.summary: Fetches catalog records and metadata JSON, builds the records lookup map, and populates facet controls.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the application by collecting DOM refs, wiring all event handlers, loading catalog data, and scheduling background index builds.

nodes.name: check_exporters.mjs
nodes.summary: Node.js assertion script that validates Markdown, JSON, CSV, and You.md export output from sample picks including edge cases like quoted titles and null fields.

nodes.name: agent.js
nodes.summary: Browser- and Node-compatible LLM agent loop that plans OTT searches via tool-calling, reranks model picks against the catalog, and emits lifecycle events. Fetch is injected (no DOM or localStorage) so the same module runs under Node test harnesses.
nodes.languageNotes: Dependency-free ES module: no imports; fetchImpl and onEvent are injected at runtime for testability.

nodes.name: callLlm
nodes.summary: Posts a non-streaming chat-completions request to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint, mapping HTTP error statuses to typed error codes (auth, credit, rate, context, network).

nodes.name: buildContextBlock
nodes.summary: Serializes viewer mood, You.md profile text, and recently-watched history into a markdown system-context block appended to the agent's message stack.

nodes.name: runAgent
nodes.summary: Main exported agent orchestrator: validates API key, runs a budgeted tool-calling loop against injected catalog tools, reranks final picks via a second LLM call, resolves title metadata, and streams status/delta/done/error events.

nodes.name: check_agent.mjs
nodes.summary: Dependency-free smoke test run with node that mocks fetch and exercises runAgent across four scenarios: happy-path tool calling with pick resolution, HTTP error-code mapping, missing API key rejection, and abort-signal handling.

nodes.name: stress_agent_hostile.mjs
nodes.summary: Hostile-input stress harness for the agent loop with fully mocked fetch (zero network calls). Runs twelve failure-mode cases covering auth/credit/rate/network errors, abort, truncated JSON, infinite tool-call loops, oversized queries, prompt injection in tool results, unicode queries, and malformed API responses.

nodes.name: makeTools
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal tools object with search_titles and get_titles handlers and schemas, accepting optional handler overrides for per-case hostile scenarios.

nodes.name: happyFetch
nodes.summary: Returns a counted mock fetch that replays a three-step happy-path LLM response sequence: tool call, interim text, and final JSON picks payload.

nodes.name: drive
nodes.summary: Test helper that invokes runAgent with default config/prompts, collects emitted events, and returns both the event log and result object for assertion.

nodes.name: store.js
nodes.summary: Wraps a pluggable storage backend (e.g. browser localStorage) with a `createStore` factory exposing typed getters/setters for the LLM connection config, the You.md taste-profile text, and watch history, all with defensive parse/serialize error handling.

nodes.name: createStore
nodes.summary: Factory that closes over a storage backend and returns an object with getLlm/setLlm, getYouMd/setYouMd, getHistory/setHistory, clearAll, and hasKey methods, each guarding storage access and JSON parsing with try/catch fallbacks.

nodes.name: check_store.mjs
nodes.summary: Dev-only smoke test that exercises `createStore` against an in-memory mock storage, asserting default values, round-trip persistence, and recovery from corrupt JSON.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to learn what India OTT Search is: a backend-free static site that ships an India streaming catalog snapshot and runs all search logic in the browser. The visitor brings their own LLM API key and optional taste context (You.md, Netflix watch history); nothing is stored on a server. This document also maps the repo layout and explains how to run the app locally and rebuild the catalog.

tour.title: Static App Shell
tour.description: The deployed app lives entirely under docs/ and index.html is its entry point. The HTML defines the search form, settings and context dialogs, export controls, and the single module-script tag that bootstraps the client-side application. There is no build step — GitHub Pages serves these files as-is.

tour.title: UI Orchestrator
tour.description: ui.js is the only browser module that imports the others; every other JS file is import-free and receives dependencies as arguments. It loads the catalog JSON, wires keyword and LLM search, renders result cards with facet filters, opens settings dialogs, and coordinates exports. Fan-out analysis confirms this file sits at the center of the frontend — understanding it gives you a map of the whole runtime.

tour.title: BM25 Search Engine
tour.description: catalog.js implements the client-side inverted index that powers keyword search over ~32k India OTT titles. It tokenizes and normalizes titles, builds a BM25 index (including lazy-loaded synopsis text), runs full-text search, and applies structured filters by provider, genre, language, year, and runtime. This module has the highest fan-in in the graph because both the UI and the agent tools depend on it.

tour.title: LLM Agent Loop
tour.description: agent.js runs the OpenAI-compatible tool-calling loop that turns natural-language queries into catalog searches and reranked picks. Fetch is injected (no DOM or localStorage) so the same module runs in the browser and in Node test harnesses. It emits lifecycle events that ui.js listens to for progress UI, and resolves model-chosen titles back against real catalog records.

tour.title: Agent Tools
tour.description: tools.js exposes the LLM-callable tool schemas and handlers — search, filter, get, and sample — that the agent loop invokes. The factory pattern injects catalog dependencies (the index, records, and filter functions from catalog.js) so tools stay testable without a browser. Together with agent.js, this is the bridge between the LLM's planning step and the deterministic catalog queries that follow.

tour.title: Storage & Watch History
tour.description: store.js wraps localStorage with typed getters and setters for the LLM connection config, You.md taste profile, and parsed watch history — all with defensive JSON parse/serialize error handling. history.js parses Netflix's exported viewing-activity CSV into structured series/movie lists and a normalized set of watched titles that the agent uses for personalization. Both modules stay import-free; ui.js wires them together at startup.

tour.title: Export Formats
tour.description: exporters.js provides pure formatters that turn search pick arrays into Markdown, JSON, CSV, or an updated You.md string — no DOM or external dependencies. ui.js calls these after a search completes so visitors can copy or download results. Keeping export logic separate from the UI controller mirrors the project's pattern of small, testable, import-free modules.

tour.title: Frozen Data Contract
tour.description: CONTRACT.md is the authoritative spec every browser module and build script must conform to without breaking consumers. It defines Title record shapes, catalog JSON schema v2, the provider registry, search index layout, localStorage keys, agent event types, tool names, and DOM element IDs. When you change any data shape or interface, start here — the validate and stress scripts enforce these rules automatically.

tour.title: Shipped Catalog Assets
tour.description: The runtime catalog ships as static JSON under docs/assets/, built ahead of time and never fetched from TMDB at browse time. catalog.json holds ~31,884 compact Title records with synopses blanked for size; catalog.text.json is a lazy-loaded synopsis sidecar merged after the main load; catalog.meta.json carries region, build timestamp, provider registry, and supported facets. These three files are what catalog.js indexes when the app starts.

tour.title: TMDB Build Pipeline
tour.description: Catalog data is collected at build time, not runtime. catalog.py sweeps TMDB discover and watch/providers endpoints for region IN into a local SQLite catalog.db, with enrich and diff subcommands for incremental updates. build_catalog_tmdb.py then unions that database with legacy uNoGS dumps and emits the schema-2 JSON assets under docs/assets/, applying CONTRACT.md id grammar and dedup rules. See catalog/README.md for sweep tuning, sharding, and the weekly cron setup.
